message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as the cover for the magazine "TEMPO," dated "29 SEPTEMBER-5 OKTOBER 2014." The layout features a white background with a thick red border on the left and a maroon band at the bottom. At the top, bold red serif letters spell "TEMPO." Above the logo, smaller black text reads: "DAFTAR SEMENTARA KABINET JOKOWI / MOELDOKO: GUE HERO DI DEPAN PRAJURIT / FREKUENSI MIRING MENTERISEMBIRING."

The central image is a black-line drawing resembling a game of hangman. On the left, a simple gallows structure is sketched. A person in a suit is drawn hanging by their right hand from the horizontal beam, their body angled and feet dangling. To the right, three rows of lettered blanks and partially filled words appear:
"PILK_D_"
"TID_K"
"L_NGSUNG"

The person's face shows an expression with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. At the bottom left, a barcode is visible next to price and publication information: "RP 35.000," "WWW.TEMPO.CO," "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126-4273."
